# BMEC

> BMEC is a statically typed language and compiler for full-stack applications.

Package: 0.9.1-beta.1
Language: 0.1

Start here:
- /ai/
- /ai/index.json
- /ai/knowledge-index.json
- /ai/ai-spec.json
- /ai/commands.json
- /ai/capabilities.json
- /ai/diagnostics.json
- /ai/examples.json
- /docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md
- /docs/CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.md
- /docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
- /docs/CAPABILITIES.md
- /version.json

For task-specific machine-readable context, use `bmec knowledge "TASK" --json`.
Use `bmec check FILE --json` to validate BMEC source and inspect stable diagnostics.
